hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "prisma[[:space:]]+(migrate|db[[:space:]]+push)"; then echo "BLOCKED: prisma migrate/db push contra prod no permitido. Usa /sql-migration para SQL manual." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*--force|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+-f([[:space:]]|$)"; then echo "BLOCKED: force-push requiere autorización explícita del usuario." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -q "prisma/schema.prisma"; then echo "⚠️  schema.prisma cambió — genera SQL standalone con /sql-migration y entrégalo al usuario para Supabase." >&2; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "app/api/(bookings|proposals|service-requests|payments)|lib/auth\.ts"; then echo "⚠️  API/auth compartida tocada — considera correr el subagent panel-impact-reviewer antes de cerrar." >&2; fi'
osascript -e 'display notification "Tarea terminada" with title "Haggo · Claude" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null || true
